column6: Description
Master the core principles of Punctuality and Discipline required for success in the 1st year of the Information & Communication Technology System Maintenance (ICTSM) trade.
Learn essential Artificial Respiration techniques and critical Electrical Safety protocols for the 1st year of the Information & Communication Technology System Maintenance (ICTSM) trade.
Discover the correct types and usage of Fire Extinguishers to ensure workplace safety in the 1st year of the Information & Communication Technology System Maintenance (ICTSM) trade.
Understand the functions, types, and essential roles of Fuses and Switches in circuit protection for the 1st year of the Information & Communication Technology System Maintenance (ICTSM) trade.
Here is a short, targeted description tailored for the ICTSM (Information & Communication Technology System Maintenance) trade:
Master the art of reading resistor color codes and using a multimeter to accurately measure and verify resistance values in ICT hardware.
Understand the fundamental relationship between voltage, current, and resistance to analyze and troubleshoot circuits in ICT systems using Ohm's Law.
Master essential soldering and desoldering techniques to securely component-mount and safely repair PCBs in ICT systems.
Learn how to safely remove components from PCBs using de-soldering pumps and wicks without damaging sensitive ICT hardware.
Understand the principles of inductance and how transformers function to step voltage up or down in ICT power supplies and circuits.
Explore the core principles of transformers and how to identify different types—like step-up, step-down, and isolation transformers—used in ICT power circuits.
Discover the causes of core and copper losses in transformers and how they impact the efficiency of ICT power supply units.
Understand the role of capacitors in storing charge, filtering noise, and stabilizing voltage within ICT electronic circuits.
Learn how to calculate and measure total capacitance when capacitors are connected in series and parallel configurations within ICT circuits.
Learn how to analyze series and parallel resonance circuits, calculate resonant frequency, and understand their critical roles in ICT communication and filtering systems.
Learn how to identify, test, and replace various fuses and switches to ensure proper circuit protection and control in ICT hardware.
Understand the fundamentals of a simple electrical circuit by exploring voltage, current, and load pathways essential for ICT hardware operation.
Learn how to interpret key diode specifications—like forward voltage, peak inverse voltage ($PIV$), and maximum current—to select the right component for ICT circuit repairs.
Understand how half-wave and full-wave rectifiers convert AC to DC to provide stable, reliable power to sensitive ICT devices.
Discover how bridge rectifiers utilize four diodes to deliver efficient, full-wave AC-to-DC power conversion for stable ICT system operations.
Learn how filters work alongside rectifiers to smooth out AC ripples and deliver clean, stable DC power to sensitive ICT components.
Understand the unique breakdown characteristics of Zener diodes and how they are used for precise voltage regulation in ICT power supply circuits.
Explore the working principles of transistors as electronic switches and amplifiers, and learn how to test them for ICT hardware troubleshooting.
Understand how to set the correct DC operating point through transistor biasing to ensure stable amplification and switching in ICT electronic circuits.
Discover how transistor-based amplifiers boost weak electronic signals to ensure clear, high-quality audio and data transmission in ICT systems.
Learn how the emitter follower circuit provides high input impedance and stable voltage gain for effective impedance matching in ICT communication systems.
Master the working principles, terminal configurations, and switching characteristics of Field Effect Transistors ($FETs$) used in modern ICT hardware and low-power circuits.
Learn the operating principles of the Unijunction Transistor ($UJT$) and how it is used as a relaxation oscillator and trigger device in ICT power control circuits.
Understand the operating principles and switching characteristics of SCRs and TRIACs used for heavy-duty power control and AC switching in ICT systems.
Learn how TRIACs and DIACs work together as bidirectional semiconductor devices to achieve precise AC voltage control and triggering in ICT power circuits.
Learn how series voltage regulators control output voltage by placing a transistor in series with the load to provide steady DC power for ICT hardware.
Discover how voltage regulators and inverters work to maintain stable DC levels and convert DC back to AC for reliable backup power in ICT infrastructure.
Explore the different types of Uninterruptible Power Supplies ($UPS$) and learn how they provide critical backup power and surge protection for ICT systems.
Master the fundamentals of Binary, Octal, Decimal, and Hexadecimal number systems and learn how to convert between them for digital logic and ICT hardware diagnostics.
Understand the fundamental operation of AND, OR, NOT, and universal logic gates used to process digital signals and execute instructions in ICT hardware.
Learn how different types of flip-flops serve as the fundamental bistable memory elements used to store binary data and build registers in ICT hardware.
Learn how to use Karnaugh Maps (K−maps) as a visual tool to simplify complex Boolean expressions and optimize digital logic circuits in ICT hardware.
Understand the operation, truth table, and toggle state of the JK flip-flop, the versatile digital memory element used to eliminate invalid states in ICT circuitry.
Master the operation of asynchronous and synchronous Up/Down counters used for tracking sequences and timing operations in digital ICT hardware.
Learn the rules of binary addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division required for computer processing and digital logic diagnostics in ICTSM.
Discover how Multiplexers (MUX) and Demultiplexers (DEMUX) route multiple digital data streams over a single line to optimize data transmission in ICT networks.
Understand how Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs) sample and quantize continuous real-world signals into discrete binary data for computer processing in ICT hardware.
Learn how shift registers store and move binary data serially or in parallel to facilitate data transfer and conversion within digital ICT systems.
Explore the construction, working principles, and maintenance of different types of rechargeable batteries used to provide reliable backup power for ICT infrastructure.
Learn the internal construction, chemical reactions, and maintenance procedures of Lead-Acid batteries used for heavy-duty power backup in ICTSM infrastructure.
Learn how to operate a Cathode Ray Oscilloscope ($CRO$) to visualize, measure, and analyze voltage waveforms and signal frequencies in electronic ICT circuits.
Learn how wave shaping circuits use diodes, resistors, and capacitors to clip or clamp electronic signals into desired waveforms for ICT equipment.
Master the essentials of operating an oscilloscope to accurately measure, visualize, and troubleshoot voltage waveforms and high-frequency signals in digital ICT hardware.
Understand how an oscilloscope acquires, processes, and displays electrical signals in real time to visualize waveforms and troubleshoot ICT hardware circuits.
Explore the advanced features, digital storage capabilities, and automated measurement functions of modern digital oscilloscopes used for high-speed signal analysis in ICT hardware diagnostics.
Understand how gears, belts, and stepper motors work together to provide precise mechanical motion control and positioning in automated ICT hardware and peripherals.
Learn the architecture, bus structures, and instruction cycles of a microprocessor, the central brain that executes data processing tasks in digital ICT hardware.
Master the essential features of MS Word to create, format, and manage professional documents, templates, and reports required in day-to-day ICT administration.
Learn how to configure page layouts and use mail merge in MS Word to efficiently automate and customize bulk document generation for professional ICT operations.
Master the essentials of MS Excel to build spreadsheets, apply formulas, and analyze data efficiently for tracking and managing resources in ICT operations.
Learn how to use essential Excel functions and formulas to automate data calculations, manipulate text, and analyze technical metrics in ICT management.
Explore the core components, processing architecture, and functional blocks of a computer system that form the foundation of IT hardware maintenance in ICTSM.
Explore the classification of computers based on size, functionality, and processing power—from microcomputers to supercomputers—used in diverse ICT infrastructures.
Discover the essential hand tools and specialized instruments required for safe, precise assembly and troubleshooting of electronic hardware in the ICTSM trade.
Learn the essential practices of preventive maintenance, component cleaning, and hardware troubleshooting to ensure the reliability and longevity of IT systems and network equipment.
Discover the core building blocks of a computer system, exploring how hardware, software, and peripheral devices interface to process data in modern ICT networks.
Learn to identify, compare, and install SIMM and DIMM memory modules in computer motherboard slots, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn the function, replacement procedures, and troubleshooting steps for the motherboard CMOS battery, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn the foundational architecture, clock speeds, and installation procedures of central processing units (CPUs), tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn the layout, component sockets, and communication pathways of a computer motherboard, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn the working principles, internal components, and voltage output regulations of a Switched-Mode Power Supply (SMPS), tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn to identify and understand the core internal and external components of a laptop, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn the step-by-step assembly, disassembly, and specific component functions of laptop hardware, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn how to configure user profiles, navigate the interface, and manage email communication essentials in MS Outlook, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn how to safely locate, clean, and permanently delete system junk files to optimize storage space, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn how to optimize system boot times, manage startup applications, and configure virtual memory settings to boost Windows performance, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn how to configure system restore points, schedule regular data backups, and recover Windows operating systems, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
Learn how to identify, download, and install correct hardware drivers to ensure seamless device compatibility, tailored for 1st-year students in the ICTSM Trade.
